queries.query: Three autonomous sessions work on one repository in parallel. Set up their claims and inbox.
Write a lane brief with owned files, the exact gate command and a Done checklist.
A lane's claim has had no status update for hours. Can another lane take it over?
Send a typed delivery message to another lane's inbox with the right file name.
The coordinator asked for a roll call. Report my lane's state.
Write a context handoff for the next session continuing this lane's work.
Which blocked items should a lane escalate to the operator and which should it decide itself?
Release my lane's claim and hand off the worktree because I am stopping.
My inbox matching picks up mail for another lane whose id starts the same. Fix the matching.
Assign this one issue to me before I start working alone in a single session.
Plan the next review round after a blocker was fixed on this branch.
Wait for the required CI checks on my pull request and diagnose the failing job.
Group finished deliveries into one release candidate and fold superseded pull requests.
Record the architectural decision to adopt a different persistence provider.
Verify that a consolidation pull request dropped none of the absorbed changes.
Find the cause of a repeated regression class across several recent fixes.
Speed up the pipeline by changing caching and shard layout.
Write the release-note bullets for this new public API.
